title: Understanding the DataFrame
text: Look at the columns in the DataFrame. Which column contains the year of renovation?

title: Identifying Relevant Columns
text: The 'renovated' column contains the year each room was last renovated. This is crucial for visualizing renovations by year.

title: Choosing the Right Visualization
text: What type of plot is suitable for showing the distribution of a numerical variable across different categories?

title: Box Plot Characteristics
text: Box plots are useful for visualizing the distribution of data and identifying outliers. They show the median, quartiles, and potential outliers.

title: Evaluating Overplotting
text: Is overplotting a concern when using box plots to visualize data?

title: Understanding Overplotting
text: Overplotting occurs when too many data points overlap, making it difficult to see individual points. Box plots summarize data, reducing this issue.
